svg.title: Tramp Merchant - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 94-95, PDF 95-96. Combined deck envelope uses broad semicircular forward accommodation body, parallel cargo hull and square aft engine/fuel shoulders. Upper fuel-only blocks sit over rear shoulders, corroborated by illustration. Top projection remains solid; cargo-room borders and internal engineering divisions excluded.
